correctness.rationale: Ordered rotation phases modulo 2pi/n give m circular spacings g_j summing L=2pi/n, and direct polar integration of the nearest supporting tangent proves A=n sum tan(g_j/2) and H=sec(max g_j/2)-1, including ties. Sample-anchored circular spacings have Dirichlet(1,...,1) representation L E_j/S from iid Exp(1). Cubic tan expansion yields A-pi=(pi^3/(3n^2m^2)) overline(E^3)/bar(E)^3 plus a fifth-power remainder with L2 norm O(m^-4); exact Dirichlet tenth mixed moments justify centering and variance scaling. Delta influence psi(E)=E^3-18E+12 has exact factorial-moment variance 360 (independently recomputed), hence m^5 Var(A) limit 40pi^6/n^4. The maximum exponential minus log m converges to standard Gumbel. Characteristic-function factorization with maximum cutoff log m+t shows the joint normal sample means and extreme converge independently, tail weighted moments O((log m)^3/m^(3/2)) negligible. Normalized H differs by o_p(1). Proved fixed n, m tends to infinity; simulations alone not used to justify asymptotics.
residual_risks: The infinite-family proof uses the explicitly inspected structural lemmas; finite tests do not establish unlimited parameters.
